name: cartridge-control
description: Система учёта картриджей с печатью этикеток
author: CartridgeControl

scripts.electron:build: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win zip dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win zip dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:exe: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win portable dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:quick: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.dist:installer: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:signed: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis zip dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:all:signed: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip dir --x64 --publish never
